# React

## Bound conventions
`docs/conventions/stack-react.md` realises `docs/conventions/frontend.md` for every React app, and
is the base `docs/conventions/stack-nextjs.md` builds on for every Next.js app. Read it beside the
core section it realises.

## Traps agents fall into here
- Route-level components live in `pages/` as `<name>-page.tsx`; a page's private files in
  `pages/<name>-page/`; never `pages/partials/`. In Next.js, the routing files under `app/` instead.
- No `useEffect` to fetch, to derive state or to relay an event: server state through TanStack Query
  (or a Server Component in Next.js), derived values during render, consequences in the handler.
- `eslint-plugin-react-hooks` errors are fixed, never disabled; a dependency left out means the
  effect is wrong.
- List keys are stable ids from the data, never the index of a list that changes.
- Server data is never copied into a client store; query keys come from the feature's key factory,
  and a mutation invalidates what it made stale.
- `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` only on HTML sanitized server-side; a URL from data is checked to be
  `http(s):` before it reaches `href` or `src`.

## Tooling
`lint` runs ESLint then Prettier; `tsc --noEmit` type-checks. Run when asked. If a change does not
show in the browser, the dev server or a build may be needed — ask, do not guess.
